cues.title: 落叶减少，碳去了哪里
cues.titleEn: Where did the leaf carbon go?
cues.caption: 落叶变少，物质并没有消失。
cues.captionEn: Less litter does not mean matter disappeared.
cues.zh: 一片落叶逐渐破碎，减少的物质去了哪里？先比较相同落叶与土层。自然土保留原状态，另一份土按教材用六十摄氏度处理一小时，尽量减弱微生物作用。处理不等于无菌，也可能改变土壤性质。因此温湿度、叶片来源和观察时间仍要一致，图中只是待检验的模型趋势。
cues.en: As a fallen leaf breaks apart, where does its material go? Compare matched leaves and soil layers. Keep one soil untreated; treat the other at sixty degrees Celsius for one hour, as in the textbook, to reduce microbial effects. That does not guarantee sterility or unchanged soil chemistry. Match moisture, temperature and observation time. These trends are model predictions, not measurements.

cues.title: 先切分，再吸收
cues.caption: 胞外切分，再吸收小分子。
cues.captionEn: Break down outside, then take up small products.
cues.zh: 放大落叶表面。许多微生物先用胞外酶切分大分子，再吸收适合利用的小分子。跟住这六份碳标记：连接先断开，标记随后经过细胞边界，碳没有凭空消失。实际还会进入细胞成分、二氧化碳等不同物质；这里合并后续步骤，没有模拟完整呼吸路径。停掉胞外切分，整条材料便不能按这条路径进入。
cues.en: Look closely at the leaf surface. Many microbes use extracellular enzymes to break large molecules down before taking up suitable small products. Follow the six carbon markers: connections break outside, then the same markers cross the cell boundary. Carbon has not disappeared. Later reactions redistribute it into cell material, carbon dioxide and other products. Those steps are grouped here. Stop outside cleavage, and this pathway cannot bring the intact material in.

cues.title: 把解释变成预测
cues.titleEn: Turn an explanation into a prediction
cues.caption: 改变水分，把预测与记录比较。
cues.zh: 孔洞多，不等于测得了减少多少质量。这里的数字来自模型；自己的记录仍留空。只有用一致的清理、干燥条件和重复样本，才能比较干质量。现在只改变水分：同样的土和落叶，在很干的条件下，模型分解变慢。预测要回到真实记录检验；干燥不是杀菌，自然土壤也不只存在这一条好氧分解路径。
cues.en: More holes do not measure mass loss. These numbers come from the model; your own records stay empty. Match cleaning, drying and replicated samples before comparing dry mass. Now change moisture alone. The same litter decomposes more slowly in the dry model. Test that prediction with observations. Dryness is not sterilization, and this aerobic pathway is not the only form of decomposition in real soil.

cues.title: 两种阴性，一个疑问
cues.caption: 剩余糖少，不等于从未生成。
cues.captionEn: Little sugar left does not mean none formed.
cues.zh: 看同一培养液的两份样品：碘液颜色浅，斐林检测也未见明显沉淀。这能证明没有分解吗？先追查土壤浸出液。纱布带走粗土粒，却可能留下微生物、胞外酶和溶解物。它们既可能分解淀粉，也可能继续利用产物，所以最后剩多少糖，不能直接等同于曾经生成多少糖。
cues.en: Two aliquots from one culture show little iodine color and no obvious Fehling precipitate. Does that prove nothing was broken down? First inspect the soil extract. Gauze removes coarse soil but can leave microbes, extracellular enzymes and dissolved substances. The extract can both break starch down and support further use of its products. Sugar remaining at the end is not the same as all the sugar previously formed.

cues.title: 分解与利用不是同一步
cues.caption: 切分与后续利用，可以分别检验。
cues.captionEn: Test cleavage and later use separately.
cues.zh: 两杯先有等量淀粉，分别加入等体积浸出液和水，在同样条件下培养。放大浸出液这一杯：先在细胞外切分，再利用产物，是两个不同过程。关闭后续利用，已形成的小分子便可留在外面；关闭酶切，整条淀粉保留。这里分别控制两条路径，是为了检验解释，不是说加热土壤能只关闭其中一条。
cues.en: Start with equal starch, then add equal volumes of extract or water and incubate under matched conditions. Inside the extract treatment, outside cleavage and later product use are distinct processes. Stop later use, and the small products can remain outside. Stop cleavage, and the intact starch remains. These independent model controls test an explanation; heating real soil would not selectively switch off just one process.

cues.title: 两份样品，两个问题
cues.caption: 两份样品，分别检验。
cues.zh: 培养结束后，取每组二十毫升培养液，分到两支试管。这个重建选择每份十毫升。跟住移液管：先在原液中吸取，抬高越过器口，再把液体送入对应试管，原液和试管体积同步变化。A一、B一用于碘液检测，A二、B二用于斐林试剂检测，不能把两种试剂加到同一份样品里。
cues.en: After incubation, take twenty milliliters from each group and divide it between two tubes. This reconstruction uses ten milliliters per aliquot. Follow the pipette as it draws below the liquid surface, clears the vessel rim and delivers into the selected tube. Source and receiving volumes change together. Use A1 and B1 for iodine, and A2 and B2 for Fehling reagent.

cues.title: 剩余淀粉的证据
cues.caption: 显色反映样品中还剩多少可检出淀粉。
cues.zh: 把碘液加入A一和B一，颜色只在试剂真正进入样品之后改变。这个示例中，水组仍有较多淀粉，颜色较深；浸出液组残留较少，蓝紫色较弱。这条证据支持淀粉发生变化，却不能单凭颜色确定是哪一种微生物、哪一种酶，或产生了多少葡萄糖。还要考虑浸出液本身的背景颜色。
cues.en: Add iodine to A1 and B1. Color changes only after reagent reaches the sample. In this example, the water control retains more starch and gives a stronger blue-purple response; the extract group retains less. This supports starch change, but does not identify the responsible organism or enzyme, or quantify glucose production. Extract background color also matters.

cues.title: 还原性产物的证据
cues.caption: 加热后的沉淀支持还原性产物存在。
cues.zh: 给A二和B二加入新配的斐林试剂，再水浴加热。示例中的浸出液组出现砖红色沉淀，水组保持阴性；不开启加热时，模型不会提前长出沉淀。斐林反应检测还原性物质，不是只认葡萄糖的专一标记。把这条证据和淀粉检测联系起来，并用浸出液空白与初始检测检查干扰。
cues.en: Add freshly prepared Fehling reagent to A2 and B2, then heat in a water bath. The example extract group develops brick-red precipitate while the water control remains negative. Without heating, the model does not generate precipitate. Fehling chemistry detects reducing substances, not glucose alone. Combine this result with the starch test and assess interference using extract blanks and initial samples.

cues.title: 迟测为何可能阴性
cues.titleEn: Why a late test can be negative
cues.caption: 产物可以先生成，随后被继续利用。
cues.captionEn: Products can form, then be used further.
cues.zh: 如果产物很快被利用，迟一点检测会怎样？先保留预测，再从同一批碳开始。淀粉减少，可溶产物先增加，随后流入其他碳库。模型百分比始终合计百分之百，标记只是一小批示例。到第七天，剩余糖很少，并不代表早先没有生成。提前检测，再结合淀粉检测、初始样和空白对照，才能更好地区分没有分解与分解后继续利用。
cues.en: What if products are used quickly and we test later? Keep that prediction in mind as the same carbon batch moves. Starch falls; soluble products first rise, then enter other carbon pools. Model percentages always total one hundred percent; the markers are only a small sample. Little sugar on day seven does not mean none formed earlier. Test earlier as well, and combine starch tests, initial samples and blank controls to distinguish no breakdown from breakdown followed by use.

chapters.title: 只改变准备检验的条件
chapters.caption: 相同落叶和土层，比较处理土与自然土。
chapters.captionEn: Compare treated and natural soil with matched litter and depth.

chapters.title: 变化需要时间和环境
chapters.titleEn: Change takes time and suitable conditions
chapters.caption: 较低分解活性下，落叶在模型中保存较多。
chapters.captionEn: Lower activity preserves more litter in this model.

chapters.title: 把观察留下来再下结论
chapters.caption: 示例数据与个人实测分开，缺测保持空白。
chapters.captionEn: Separate example values from measurements; missing data stay blank.

chapters.title: 留下浸出液，取出粗土
chapters.titleEn: Retain the extract and remove coarse soil
chapters.caption: 纱布带走粗土，液体仍可含微生物与可溶物。
chapters.captionEn: Gauze removes coarse soil; microbes and solutes can remain.

chapters.title: 浸出液与水作对照
chapters.caption: A加30 mL浸出液，B加30 mL水，其他条件一致。
chapters.captionEn: A receives 30 mL extract; B receives 30 mL water.

chapters.title: 同一培养液分成两份
chapters.titleEn: Split the incubation into separate aliquots
chapters.caption: 碘液与斐林试剂检测不同份，不混在一起。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine and Fehling reagent test separate aliquots.

chapters.title: 先看还剩多少淀粉
chapters.caption: 碘液接触样品后，残留淀粉产生蓝紫色。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine contact reveals remaining starch as blue-purple color.

chapters.title: 另一份样品检测还原性
chapters.titleEn: Test reducing substances in the other aliquot
chapters.caption: 新配斐林试剂加热后，才观察砖红色沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Heat fresh Fehling reagent before inspecting brick-red precipitate.

chapters.title: 产物也会继续被利用
chapters.caption: 淀粉已减少，末次还原糖仍可能很低。
chapters.captionEn: Starch can decline while final reducing sugar remains low.

bio-elective-2-065-1.label: 落叶是在土壤微生物的作用下腐烂的吗

bio-elective-2-066-1.label: 探究土壤微生物对淀粉的分解作用

question.zh: 落叶破碎后，减少的物质去了哪里？
question.en: Where does material go as litter breaks down?

lead.zh: 从同源落叶对照，追踪胞外切分与吸收，再预测干燥的影响。
lead.en: Follow matched litter through outside cleavage and uptake, then predict a moisture change.

principle.zh: 有机物可在胞外酶作用后被利用；处理对照提供证据，不能单凭叶片孔洞证明完整转化路径。
principle.en: Extracellular breakdown enables further use; controls provide evidence, while holes alone do not establish a complete pathway.

question.zh: 同样土壤更干燥，叶片一定完全不分解吗？
question.en: Does drier soil guarantee no decomposition at all?

explanation.zh: 不能。这条好氧模型预测减慢；真实土壤还受温度、氧和不同生物过程影响，需记录检验。
explanation.en: No. This aerobic model predicts slowing; temperature, oxygen and other biological processes also matter. Test with observations.

question.zh: 没有检出糖，就没有发生淀粉分解吗？
question.en: Does a negative sugar test mean no starch breakdown?

lead.zh: 两种独立检测连到同一批碳的生成、保留与继续利用。
lead.en: Connect two independent tests to formation, persistence and further use of the same carbon.

principle.zh: 终点浓度由生成和消耗共同决定；低剩余量不能等同于零生成量。
principle.en: Final abundance reflects production and use; little remaining does not imply none was produced.

question.zh: 加快后续利用，早测和晚测会给出相同判断吗？
question.en: If later use speeds up, will early and late tests agree?

explanation.zh: 未必。模型中可溶产物先积累再降低，需用时间序列、初始样和空白区分解释。
explanation.en: Not necessarily. Soluble products can rise then fall; time series, initial samples and blanks help distinguish explanations.

sources.title: Nam Sun Wang, University of Maryland — Starch Hydrolysis by Amylase
sources.readScope: Full webpage read. Used for varied starch hydrolysis products, iodine residual-starch interpretation, initial/background controls and time-course distinction. Its reducing-sugar procedure uses DNS, so it is not a source for this textbook Fehling protocol.

sources.title: 人教版高中生物学 选择性必修2 生物与环境，P61–67（实验P65–66）
sources.readScope: Full extracted section, two experiment pages rendered and visually read. Textbook leaves results blank; no observation numbers copied.

sources.title: Olagoke et al. (2020), Persistent Activities of Extracellular Enzymes Adsorbed to Soil Minerals
sources.readScope: Full XML body read; Methods 2.1/2.2 and results/discussion establish added amylase/cellulase activity and persistence. No numerical curve is used or transferred to natural-soil culture.
sources.supports: Cell-free extracellular enzymes can remain catalytically active; mineral adsorption effects are context-dependent, not universally protective.

sources.title: Hill, Farrar & Jones (2008), Decoupling of microbial glucose uptake and mineralization in soil
sources.readScope: Publisher and institutional abstract read, not full article or raw figures. Used only for qualitative distinction between uptake and later mineralization, no rates borrowed.

sources.title: IUBMB EC3.2.1.1 — alpha-amylase
sources.readScope: Full entry read; endohydrolysis, not conversion by one enzyme exclusively to glucose.

sources.readScope: Entry checked to distinguish beta-glucan cleavage from alpha-amylase; leaf material is not called starch.

topic.title: 落叶不见了，碳去了哪里？
topic.titleEn: Where does the carbon go when litter disappears?
topic.description: 沿同一批碳追踪胞外分解与继续利用，解释为什么迟测糖可能得到阴性。
topic.descriptionEn: Track extracellular breakdown and further use to explain why a late sugar test can be negative.

limits: All numeric curves/color intensities are illustrative, not textbook measurements.
C1–C6 are carbon portions, not single atoms/molecules; multiple reactions grouped.
Other carbon pools are not all CO2: biomass, metabolites and mineralized carbon are not separately solved.
24 marker histories are a finite sample; analytic mass fractions are independent ensemble expectations.
60°C for 1h is not claimed sterile or chemically unchanged.
No new TTS/actual site/subjective listening/physical device evidence in candidate.
